data.name: Romina
data.gender_notes: Romina is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Romina is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama', meaning 'Goddess of Love and Beauty'. In Hindu mythology, Romina is considered to be an embodiment of the divine feminine, symbolizing love, compassion, and nurturing energy. The name Romina carries the meaning “Little Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Romina usually hope their child will grow to embody little goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Romina is a spiritual name that represents the divine feminine energy, signifying love, compassion, and nurturing. It is believed that the name connects the bearer with the divine feminine energy, providing strength, courage, and guidance in life.
data.etymology: Romina belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Romina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
